rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese choice for the act or process of raising pressure in a space or container.

example.english: The plane needs pressurization before takeoff so the cabin can maintain normal air pressure.
example.traditional: 飛機起飛前要做加壓，等機艙保持正常氣壓。
